TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the complete closure of one carriageway on Master Plan Road (Masoodpur → Aruna Asaf Ali Marg) for CC road construction by DDA from 08.10.2025 to 22.10.2025:

📍 Residents of Sectors B-10, B-9, B-8 advised to use Nelson Mandela Marg to enter and Aruna Asaf Ali Marg to exit.
📍 Masoodpur Red Light now two-way only, no right turn to Bhagwan Mahavir Marg (B-10) or U-turn allowed.
📍 School buses, vans, parents dropping/picking students advised to plan routes.
📍 Commuters urged to use alternate routes.
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

[6:37PM] #Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

Movement from Oyebanji intersection to Police Post via Oba's Palace along Adeniji Adele Road, traffic is moving smoothly. 
However, there's a flash flood at John Street junction, causing slow movement from underneath the Idumota pedestrian bridge down to Eyin Eyo, connecting Balogun and Martins Streets. 
Meanwhile, the route from Tinubu Square to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street, enroute to Carter Bridge via Tom Jones intersection, is reporting normal traffic flow. 
Drivers are advised to exercise caution and consider alternative routes to minimize delays.

#FollowLASTMA
